name: codex-dsh-tts
description: Codex DSH with a local Windows TTS nudge when a decision question is unanswered for one minute.

interface.shortDescription: Ask, then gently call you back.
interface.longDescription: Adds the same in-task decision checkpoints as Codex DSH, plus an optional Windows voice reminder after 60 seconds without a response.
defaultPrompt: Ask me during the task and use TTS if I go quiet.
